changelog:
Initial release of ai-seo skill — optimization for AI search engine citation and AI-generated answers:

- Introduces expert guidance on getting content cited by AI search engines and assistants (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot).
- Defines a user interview process to assess current AI visibility, content types, goals, and competitive landscape.
- Details how AI search works, key differences from traditional SEO, and citation patterns across platforms.
- Provides an AI Visibility Audit framework: how to check citation status, audit content extractability, and ensure AI bot access.
- Outlines an optimization strategy focused on structure (extractability), authority (citation-worthiness), and presence (being where AI looks).
- Includes checklists, practical tips, and references for deeper technical details.
